entities.name: Akın Öztürk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Akın Öztürk is a former four-star general in the Turkish Air Force who served as the 30th Commander of the Turkish Air Force until August 4, 2015. After his expiration as commander, he continued his duty as a member of the Supreme Military Council.

entities.name: Akın Öztürk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Akın Öztürk is a former four-star general in the Turkish Air Force who served as the 30th Commander of the Turkish Air Force until August 4, 2015. After his expiration as commander, he continued his duty as a member of the Supreme Military Council.
